headline: Fujifilm to boost tape production fivefold amid AI storage demand
summary: Fujifilm plans to increase magnetic tape manufacturing capacity by as much as five times, citing surging demand for AI-related data storage. One report puts the investment at $63 million, calling it the industry's largest tape investment in two decades.

claims.statement: Fujifilm plans to increase its magnetic tape production capacity by up to five times.

sources.quote: Fujifilm plans to increase the production of magnetic tape by as much as 5x as it works to meet a newfound demand for AI data center storage.

claims.statement: The production increase is driven by rising demand for AI-related data storage.
